summary: Gorax tests whether players should prioritize Child of Chaos Inspiration 1 or his exclusive artifact, Dragonbone Catalyst. In tests on Temporal Vortex II, Inspiration 1 achieved 184.5 million damage while equipping the exclusive artifact at Inspiration 0 reached 191.8 million damage. The exclusive artifact offers a higher overall team damage output than Inspiration 1, though alternative offensive artifacts like Golden Antlers or Orb of the Dragon God can serve as temporary substitutes. Child of Chaos remains a strong, versatile support for clearing domains and competing in PvP, particularly for newer players.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: Strong Support / Prioritize Exclusive Artifact over I1
heroes.note: His exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst provides a higher team damage increase in PvE than Inspiration 1, while his kit provides valuable AOE immunity and multi-element flexibility.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Provides team survivability in Temporal Vortex and must maintain higher max HP than Child of Chaos to absorb single-target boss hits.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Applies poison vulnerability and debuffs to boost overall team poison DPS.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Requires tight skill timing to stack over 30 poison ticks on the boss.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Works alongside Sacredeia and Twitch to form the core poison damage engine.

teams.note: High-damage poison Vortex rotation utilizing Child of Chaos for damage amplification and Oggok for tanking.

tips: Prioritize getting Child of Chaos's exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst over getting his Inspiration 1 copy if forced to choose.
Keep Child of Chaos's HP lower than your main tank (such as Oggok) to prevent him from taking single-target boss executes.
If you only have one copy of Child of Chaos, substitute artifacts like Golden Antlers or Orb of the Dragon God to still gain substantial damage bonuses.
Child of Chaos's Inspiration 1 defense penalty debuff on ultimate often overlaps with the Misty Conch artifact effect, reducing its comparative value in PvE.
title: Is Child of Chaos Artifact Better Than Inspiration 1? | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
